{{Quote|Well fought, lowly man.''"<br />"''Well fought, traditional oppressor.|Firen Nuln and Luke Skywalker after a sparring match|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
'''Firen Nuln''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. She was the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] trainer for the [[Raining Leaves Clan]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Nuln was one of the nine Witches of the Raining Leaves Clan who [[Skirmish in the Dathomiri rainforest|attempted to stop]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] from approaching their territory during their upcoming [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] with the all-male [[Broken Columns Clan]]. However, the Skywalkers defeated the Witches, with the help of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]], the Dathomiri [[Tribeless Sha]], [[Carrack]], and [[Yliri Consta]]. The Witches then allowed the Skywalkers, the Solos, Stadd, Sha, Carrack, and Consta to attend the Conclave. After suffering several attacks by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], the conclave was moved to the newly-christened [[Bright Sun Hill|Jedi Hill Camp]], where the two clans were merged into one clan, [[Bright Sun Clan]]. There, Nuln participated in the [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|final battle]] with the Nightsisters, which the Bright Sun Clan won.
